comments.author: theli0nheart
comments.story: A wind-powered vehicle that can travel twice as fast as the wind itself
comments.why: Good explanation of why the vehicle works, like a sailboat
comments.text: I thought the video below provided a good explanation for why this works. The physics are similar to those of a single sailboat going faster than the wind. Imagine two sailboats on a cylindrical ocean on diagonal tacks, on opposite poles, and rotating around the core with rods connecting them to the core. Now you have a propeller. :) [VIDEO]

comments.why: Visual explanation of how the wind-powered vehicle gains energy from air
comments.text: The visual that made it click for me was at 18:54 in the original video[0]. It shows the air hitting the propeller losing kinetic energy which becomes the energy ultimately making the vehicle go. I also don't know how you can watch the treadmill video and doubt it after seeing it go up the treadmill unless you believed it was a complete hoax. [0] [VIDEO]
